key_findings.expiry_today_badge_live_confirmed: CONFIRMED via Playwright — NIFTY07APR22850PE custom position (Apr 7, 2026 expiry) correctly shows pulsing red 'EXPIRY TODAY — Exit Before 3:30 PM' badge. Previously was showing 'Best Exit: 08 Apr (T+1)'. BUG IS FIXED.
key_findings.best_exit_today_confirmed: CONFIRMED — Best Exit shows 'T+0 Trading Days (Today (Exit Before 3:30 PM)) @ ₹82.10' not 'tomorrow'. Session-sigma formula in use.
key_findings.dual_field_expiry_detection: CONFIRMED — Custom position refresh checks position.get('expiry_date') or position.get('expiry') with format normalization. Both field names handled.
key_findings.high_confidence_targets: CONFIRMED — compute_atr_based_fno_targets(high_confidence=True) uses 0.35x/0.65x sigma multipliers. Live function call verified HC T1 < standard T1 and HC T2 < standard T2.
key_findings.near_expiry_badge_logic: CONFIRMED — near_expiry_badge=(remaining_trading_days == 2) — fires only for next-day expiry (not same-day, not 3+ days)
key_findings.hc_trigger_factor: CONFIRMED — AssuredTargets:HC{score} appended to trigger_factors when confluence_score >= 80
key_findings.same_day_t2_cap: CONFIRMED — T2 capped at entry * 2.0 (100% gain) on expiry day to keep targets realistic
key_findings.session_sigma_formula: CONFIRMED — _ss_sd = _atr_sd * sqrt(_frac_sd) * _vf_sd used for same-day best exit (not full-day ATR)
key_findings.frontend_no_js_errors: CONFIRMED — No JS errors or page errors detected on login, dashboard, F&O tab
key_findings.get_remaining_trading_days_1_for_today: CONFIRMED at 11:08 IST (market open) — function logic includes today when market_still_open_today=True and today is weekday
